newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain jobless rise due to seasonal factors - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain jobless rise due to seasonal factors - Rato.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday that the rise in the September unemployment rate was due to seasonal factors in the service sector.
"The increase in September unemployment is a consequence of the seasonalisty of service sector employment," Rato told journalists.
He also said that the key to controlling inflation was the maintainance of a climate of wage moderation.
"It's one of the most important and probably the most important thing in keeping inflation pressures (under control) in the future," Rato said. --Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
